title: PageSpec
description: A page composition. Styling is owned by section/component contracts; a node may only choose catalog tokens for its `tokens` slots (no raw style values). `mode` is required: "clone" = faithful reconstruction of owner.com (real copy and clone-only assets allowed as evidence); "generation" = a new page for another brand built from this design repo (no owner.com identity, copy, people, customers, claims, URLs, embeds or clone-only / blocked assets; enforced by semantic_validate.py GENERATION_MODE_* rules).

theme.description: Optional; must be one of registry.manifest.json schemaValidatedThemes (TOKEN_THEME_UNKNOWN).

brand.description: Generation mode: the fictional / operator brand the page is for.

tokens.description: Optional per-node token choices. Every value must be a catalog token id of the slot's category (tokens/llm/token-catalog.json pageSpecSlots); raw values, unknown ids, unsupported fonts and invalid theme combinations are rejected by semantic_validate.py TOKEN_* rules.
